verdict.rationale: Sketch's docs confirm free web-based developer handoff without needing the Mac app, allowing inspection of designs and measurements/styles via the web app, but the evidence does not explicitly confirm code snippet generation for CSS/iOS/Android within this inspect mode (only AI-related code export features for building frames in code are mentioned, not inspector-panel code snippets). missing for 10: explicit confirmation of CSS/iOS/Android code snippet generation in the developer inspect view, independent/hands-on corroboration of the handoff experience.
